description: This source file defines the `PcChargeApi` class, which provides methods to create, modify, send, and process XML-based API requests for a third-party payment processing system within the OFBiz framework. It manages XML document construction, XML parsing, and socket communication for payment transactions.

classes.name: PcChargeApi
classes.description: A class that facilitates creation, manipulation, and network transmission of XML requests for a payment processing system, including support for handling request/response XML documents over TCP sockets.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a specified field in the XML request document with a given value after type conversion.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified field from the XML response document.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes the internal XML document to a string representation.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Returns the internal XML Document object.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to the configured host and port, transmits the XML request, and processes the XML response received.
